passages.provision_quote: A public agency shall not impose or enforce any minimum automobile parking requirement on a residential, commercial, or other development project if the project is located within one-half mile of public transit.
passages.note: Removes parking minimums near transit for private development; a land-use rule, not a transportation-investment split.
Aye vote on concurrence; the bill's parking-minimum provision is adjacent to the investment-split question, per the annex hard case on parking rules.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 52 Noes Count 17 NVR Count 11

rows.reasoning: AB 2097 bars local parking minimums on development within a half-mile of transit; per the annex's 'Parking rules on private builders' hard case, this is a land-use rule on private developers, not transportation investment, so it is adjacent to the rungs' question of where government invests. No passage survives V2 to support a chair.
